findings.claim: C024 removed six names from the render barrel, and that left them with no importer outside their own file. They still carry `export`: LIGHT_DIRECTION and TOON_STEPS (materials/index.ts:23,26), frameWidthFor (camera.ts:38) and RenderRole (outline.ts:21). This is the exact case C007 cleans up tonight for the other symbols, so the narrowing is half done.
findings.evidence: A repo-wide grep (excluding node_modules) for `\b(frameWidthFor|LIGHT_DIRECTION|TOON_STEPS|RenderRole)\b` finds only same-file uses: materials/index.ts:44,46,47,95,96,153 (LIGHT_DIRECTION/TOON_STEPS), camera.ts:47,53 (frameWidthFor) and outline.ts:87,92,103 (RenderRole). It finds no importer in src/, tests/, harness/, guardrails/ or spikes/. Before the diff, the barrel re-exported each of them (diff lines 37,40,41). After the diff nothing imports them, but `export const LIGHT_DIRECTION`, `export const TOON_STEPS`, `export function frameWidthFor` and `export type RenderRole` are still there.
findings.suggestedFix: Drop the `export` keyword from LIGHT_DIRECTION and TOON_STEPS (materials/index.ts:23,26), frameWidthFor (camera.ts:38) and RenderRole (outline.ts:21). It is keyword-only with no runtime effect, the same as C007. Or add them to the cleanup list for the next maintenance night.

checked.how: Grepped /work (not node_modules) for frameWidthFor|attachOutline|groundMesh|outlinedFlatMesh|solidMesh|RenderRole|LIGHT_DIRECTION|TOON_STEPS|CameraRig|DustPool|CarObject|Materials. Nothing imports them through the barrel. groundMesh/solidMesh/outlinedFlatMesh/Materials/CarObject still have direct importers (scene.ts, car.ts, dust.ts). The rest are now same-file only (F1).

Diff line 42 keeps countdownOffsetEast, CAMERA, cameraAngles, cameraDistance and createCameraRig. Lines 43-48 keep buildCar, playerLivery, createMaterials, toonShade, TOP_FACE_MIN_Y, MeshBuilder and allNormalsUp.
The grep shows only same-file uses: geometry.ts:145, outline.ts:55,104, materials/index.ts:136,148,173. No export is left and no re-export remains.

checked.target: CameraRig, DustPool (types returned by exported createCameraRig/createDust)
checked.how: Only same-file uses. They are the public return types of exported factories, so keeping them exported is reasonable and I did not report them.

Read the diff. bodyTs is pushed in the same order (-half, 0, half, then lip and foot per ramp), and bodyHs is filled after all pushes, matching the old ts.map. pose is read straight away in carView, and the resting branch has the same ternary semantics. groundAt does not re-enter groundUnderBody. No other copy of the ts/hs code is left in src (clones.md: none).
The scratch stays in src/sim/car.ts, which has no render or DOM imports. The render barrel changes are export-list only, and no material construction moved out of materials/.
Diff lines 102, 234 and 10 are comment-only. I grepped for 'panel takes over': nothing else remains.
clones.md reports no clones. The diff adds no duplicated helper.
